arguments.query: Imported .012 span-limit tables carry an uncharacterized between-angle policy, so a Method-2 steel pole is unplaceable off a knot

report.title: Imported .012 span-limit tables carry an uncharacterized between-angle policy, so a Method-2 steel pole is unplaceable off a knot
report.detail: Observed: after reconcile_capacity_case_bindings --scope adopt_criterion_set repaired Model 2's Method-2 bindings, the steel candidates l-s-stay.012 and l-s-stay.014 stop being refused for 'represents no check' and are evaluated at every station -- but every station between two authored angle knots is still refused with capacity_indeterminate, detail 'the capacity artifact's angle knots do not cover this station's line angle: UnresolvedBetweenAnglePolicy { source_policy: "uncharacterized_between_angle_v1" }'. The .012 translator sets AngleInterpolationPolicy::AdapterDefined{uncharacterized_between_angle_v1} for every imported span-limit set (pls_struct/translate.rs), and span_envelope_between_angle_policy maps that to Unresolved. So an imported Method-1/.012 table can only answer at an exact authored angle. Expected: the between-angle rule PLS-CADD 16.81 actually applies to a Method-1 allowable-span table, characterized against the native program, so the imported policy resolves to a verified token. Acceptance: a structure whose table authors knots at 0 and 15 deg is evaluable at 7 deg with a verdict DS and PLS agree on.
report.blocked_on: Characterized PLS-CADD16.81 between-angle rule and exact 0/15 degree-table verdict at 7 degrees; retain exact-knot and unknown-policy controls.

latest_note.author: nisunze@yahoo.fr
latest_note.text: The owning regression an_uncharacterized_between_angle_policy_answers_only_at_an_exact_knot passes: an exact authored knot is evaluable, the same station between knots refuses UnresolvedBetweenAnglePolicy by name with no spotting commands, and an explicitly characterized piecewise-linear control succeeds. The imported .012 policy remains intentionally uncharacterized; changing it to interpolation would invent capacity. Filed closure requires native PLS-CADD16.81 evidence for the table with 0/15 degree knots at 7 degrees and an exact DS/native verdict comparison. No native evidence, capacities, model designs or tolerance changes were manufactured.
latest_note.blocked_on: Characterized PLS-CADD16.81 between-angle rule and exact 0/15 degree-table verdict at 7 degrees; retain exact-knot and unknown-policy controls.
